arStrings.szText: ...though Athulua was weary of Philios joining her crew, she was moved by his compassionate heart and indomitable spirit. He quickly earned her trust, rising in the ranks.
Formal, an entry in a historical record.
In a short time, Philios was only outranked by Kethryes, Athulua’s first mate and lover. Kethryes was gifted with a mastery of the wind, allowing their ship to sail every corner of Sanctuary...
